title: Keep coherent leakage, stability and memory capacity as separate constraints
statement: The two-lead model has S=I-2i vv*/(D+i(Gamma_a+Gamma_s)), v=(sqrt(Gamma_a),sqrt(Gamma_s)). For incoming signal, selected error squared=4*[D^2+Gamma_s*(Gamma_a+Gamma_s)]/[D^2+(Gamma_a+Gamma_s)^2]. With zeta=3/2000,chi=201 and E in[2/5,9/5], analytic bounds give selected<0.005478/off<0.009951. The declared uncertainty box gives0.00675/0.00996 and Schur>0.6625. Stability requires zeta^2<=sqrt(11)/10, much weaker than1-percent coherent output control.
